Name: Rocky lake edge
Description: Waves slapping a lake's rocky edge or stone wall (ShoreSpec.LakeRock, ShoreSynth): thrown back off the stone, closing on air in the gaps. Its box is the stretch of edge it stands for: X its length along the edge, Z the fetch, how far the water reaches straight out from it; turn the entity so its +Z faces the water. Silent in a calm. Not a recording and not a loop.
